displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads H8 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: High line voltage: the unit may seem to run normally, but the compressor protector may be open (compressor and outdoor fan off).
causes: Supply voltage above the specified range
diySteps: Technician: check that the voltage to the system is within specification; if not, check the voltage wires and involve the electric company if necessary
Technician: if the voltage is within specification, replace the board
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician (and the electric company if the supply voltage is high).
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
